name: libxsmm-n512-sixteen-panel32-calls
hypothesis: Replace the n=512 full-kernel call with sixteen supplied panel32 calls. Bands r=0,32,...,480 cover all output rows exactly once; slots [4]=B, [10]=A+r*512 and [16]=C+r*512 implement the supplied row-major mapping. Other slots remain zero. This tests 64 KiB per-call packing against additional call and SME transition costs. No fallible setup is added; the original full512 kernel remains available unchanged. General sizes, tails, n<=0, FP32 arithmetic and both complete license notices remain unchanged. Compilation, full-GEMM correctness and performance are untested. Promotion requires fresh paired controls under the fixed gates and unchanged battery power/settings; throughput above 1800 GFLOP/s is not established.

edits.old: /* Optional generated 32-row primitive. Baseline gemm above does not call it. */
edits.new: /* Supplied generated 32-row primitive, called for each n=512 output band. */
